title: 1638 Prairie stands on its basement, up its photograph's ten steps
items: The Shortall-Gregory house now stands on a basement, its front door 1.55 m above the sidewalk, and a stoop of ten steps climbs to it between its cheek walls, as the old photograph shows.
The photographer turns out to have stood on the far sidewalk of Prairie Avenue, so the porch and tower were re-measured from that spot and now line up with the picture.
